dimensions.name: Seguridad y privacidad
evidence: Strict per-tool provider allowlists and an exact mocked OpenAI payload snapshot close the raw/internal/identity/finance disclosure boundary.
Hashed allowlisted logs, an escaped untrusted-data prompt boundary, server-controlled tools and read-only authenticated clients are covered by tests.
remainingGaps: Conversation RLS and retention have not been applied or tested remotely.
Remote provider retention, environment variables and stdout retention are not verified.

dimensions.name: Integración con Opportunity Finder
evidence: The AI now reads owner-scoped persisted V2 jobs/results with status, pipeline, pagination and safe-filter enforcement without rerunning the matcher.
Set 01 AI, CSV and XLSX code paths agree in ES/EN/ZH on 11/9/5/8/2/2/1/1/1 and preserve MPN identity and allocation order.
remainingGaps: Artifact-tool inspect/render was blocked by missing runtime sandboxPolicy.
Remote RLS and deployed UI/export parity are not verified.

dimensions.name: Exactitud de intención
evidence: A typed deterministic ES/EN/ZH catalog now owns aliases, priority, parameters, permission, server tool, confidence and clarification.
Fuzzy phrasing, ambiguity, help, Opportunity Finder concepts, hostile tool requests and text-preserving MPN extraction are regression-tested.

dimensions.name: Multidioma
evidence: Deterministic assistant, error, timeout, rate-limit, Opportunity Finder and voice states exist in ES, EN and ZH.
Question language overrides the UI fallback and equivalent Set 01 intents select the same tool and counts.
remainingGaps: Native-speaker acceptance and browser visual rendering, including Chinese fonts, are not verified.

dimensions.name: Robustez de API
evidence: Strict schemas and mocked route tests cover the required 400/401/403/404/413/422/429/502/503/504 classes.
No-store, trace redaction, bounded timeouts, cancellation classification and the retry/fallback policy are tested.
remainingGaps: Post-header SSE failures use a terminal event instead of a new HTTP status.
Production proxy limits and connection cancellation are not verified.

dimensions.name: Memoria, streaming y experiencia
evidence: Owner-only persistent-memory contracts, an eight-message safe window, deletion and isolation are implemented with an additive migration.
Ordered progress, cancellation, history, copy, new/delete conversation, evidence/source labels, dialog semantics and focus trapping are covered by route and RTL tests.
remainingGaps: The migration and RLS policies are not applied remotely.
Browser visual and physical iPad behavior are not verified.

dimensions.name: Voz
evidence: Voice now has visible provider consent, early validation, timeouts, cancellation, no-store, sanitized TTS input and safe text fallback.
Mocked provider, route, playback, cancellation and responsive tests cover the required failure and success cases.
remainingGaps: Real OpenAI and ElevenLabs behavior and retention are not verified.
Physical Safari, iPad and iPhone behavior is not certified.

dimensions.name: Rendimiento
evidence: Opportunity Finder uses persisted paginated results, and stock-needs uses one bounded safe-field query without raw payloads or per-upload N+1.
Explicit limits and a mocked deterministic P95 below two seconds are contract-tested.
remainingGaps: Production latency, query plans, concurrency and memory are not measured.

dimensions.name: Observabilidad
evidence: Sanitized metrics now include success, failure, timeout, rate limit, dimensions, tokens, fallback, language and channel.
Successful info events persist, warn failures are counted and an additive bounded retention function is tested without scheduling it.
remainingGaps: Retention migration and scheduling are not applied remotely.
Production dashboard, log sink retention and provider token reporting are not verified.

dimensions.name: Pruebas y QA
evidence: The final mocked suite passed 90 files and 416 tests versus 310 at baseline, adding 106 tests.
All requested local categories plus typecheck, lint, production build and Set 01 code-level parity passed.
remainingGaps: Artifact-tool inspect/render and browser visual QA were blocked by missing runtime sandboxPolicy.
Remote RLS, live providers, physical devices and production load remain unverified.
